Counterproductive patterns and informations become stuck in our energy bodies, not to mention the many labels placed upon us by society. It's no surprise our self-images often become distorted.

According to folk traditions, tarragon invigorates the soul, vetiver supports the sense of stability and cardamom boosts the inner strength. The synergy of these plants invigorate your instinct for life, they inspire self confidence in your decisions and strengthen you when the obstacles in every day life leave you feeling brittle and fragile. I created the confidence serum to help you in this chaotic world, to return your inner strength and empower your alignment with your inner values.

Ritual · how to use

For 28 days, mornings & evenings add 2 drops into your palms, rub them together then inhale the scent deeply 7 times. Add your positive affirmation or mantra (using your mother tongue) and repeat them 3x. Saying mantras, positive affirmations out loud every day for 28 days or repeating them occasionally 108 times can do miracles. Here is one for you to practice: "I believe in myself. I'm excited about my talents, gifts, and qualities." After 28 days of use, keep one week of break, then continue the same way until you finish the formula.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Artemisia dracunculus (tarragon), Vetiveria zizanoides (vetiver), Pinus ponderosa (Ponderosa pine), Elettaria cardamomum (cardamom), Ocimum basilicum (basil) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Find a new hobby that excites you and brings you joy and satisfaction or simply return to an old one that used to made you happy but life happened and it slowly faded away from you schedule.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours. In case of epilepsy handle with care.
